set.body:
Objective

Implement the general law that every direct-sum decomposition of node measurement space induces a crossed block decomposition of every requested edge.

Scope and deliverables

- Lift ordered measurement components through left and right direct sums.
- Implement coherent/configuration as the first certified decomposition.
- Preserve coherent orientation and configuration-subspace identity.
- Support raw entries only for scientifically identified oriented component bases.
- Provide invariant block summaries for unoriented configuration subspaces.
- Make recomposition and reversal generic so future frequency, cortical-depth, gradient, and fixed-latent decompositions need no new engine.

Acceptance evidence

- Crossed component blocks reassemble the undecomposed measurement form exactly.
- Coherent plus configuration metrics reproduce current total geometry.
- Left/right reversal transposes and swaps crossed components.
- Singular values, Frobenius norms, subspace angles, canonical summaries, and geometry alignment remain invariant under configuration-basis rotation where mathematically required.
- Raw rotated entries change and are rejected as basis-free interpretations.
- Existing node coherent/configuration views remain numerically unchanged.

Ownership boundary

Own generic decomposition lifting and coherent/configuration adapters. Additional named scientific decompositions are future extensions.

Deferred non-goals

No automatic spectral bands, cortical layers, subject-specific components, or learned decomposition fitting.
set.title: Epic 6: Lift node measurement decompositions onto edge blocks
